The device tour now shows the actual selected phone in the same Simulator window: **iPhone Duo → Pixel Fold → iPhone 16 → Duo**. The HTML report links open rendered previews on GitHub Pages.

- Replace the mismatched picker/gameplay split with 39 chronological native captures over 31.2 seconds, including Duo inner/outer screens and landscape layout.
- Remove independent gameplay panes from the filter, favorites, export and comparison walkthroughs. Keep genuine device surrounds and camera cutouts.
- Fix Jelly Garden gravity: falling tiles stay above slot backgrounds, and buttons target their new cell after moving.
- Refresh the 180-frame Duo gameplay and screen-switch recordings with the corrected sample.

[Open report previews](https://dghn.github.io/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools/) · [Feature tour](https://github.com/dghn/editorcraft-device-simulator-tools#the-workflow)

## Validation

- Unity 6000.6.5f1: warning-free compilation and native pointer gameplay on Duo; real profile switching to Pixel Fold and iPhone 16.
- Two actual Button.onClick regression moves, including a relocated tile: expected scores, 49 unique tiles, current coordinate binding, and every tile above the slot backgrounds.
- Static package checks and all seven installer tests.
- Report/image link validation and GIF device/frame review.

Playback is edited for readability. The native tour is sampled window captures, not continuous desktop video. The existing 11-orientation audit is a geometric snapshot report; it does not assess readability. No fresh Unity 2022.3 sample replay or clean Git-install test is claimed for this patch.
